authority_scope: DWC project continuity only; does not select Multiversal software roadmap work

execution_frontier.name: Controlled DWC-native acoustic training and evaluation
execution_frontier.summary: Direct Piper exact-custom-ID warm-start viability was already established in prior work and reaffirmed by the owner on 2026-09-08. A repeat warm-start smoke is authorized as reproducibility/revalidation, not rediscovery. The forward frontier is bounded acoustic training beyond the smoke test, checkpoint/sample production, and pronunciation/intelligibility evaluation while preserving exact DWC phoneme control.
do_not_regress_to: whether the ONNX proxy can render DWC
whether the direct custom-ID warm-start path is viable

verified_achievements.fact: DWC language/etymology/PSS/CNS work progressed through the pre-audio TTS handoff.
An engine-independent DWC frontend exists that produces exact custom phoneme IDs.
A synthetic exact-ID aligned DWC bootstrap corpus of 799 utterances exists and passed the prior exact-ID Piper preflight.
verified_achievements.evidence: Prior MHT transcript plus DWC recovery record

verified_achievements.fact: The neural proxy rendered 199/199 DWC regression utterances, reported 0 unsupported CNS IPA symbols in that set, produced about 4.6 minutes of audio, and bypassed English G2P.
Piper v1.8.0 source inspection established direct owner-supplied phoneme-ID dataset support via dataset_type=phoneme_ids.
Piper source inspection established vocoder_warmstart_ckpt support.

The prior work established that the intended pretrained Piper/LJSpeech checkpoint can warm-start the direct DWC exact-custom-ID path. A future rerun is a reproducibility gate, not the first proof of viability.
verified_achievements.evidence: Owner correction on 2026-09-08 confirming the prior result; preceding execution work had advanced beyond the stale recovery summary. Revalidation may be performed to create fresher machine evidence.

prior_runtime_checkpoint_parts.interpretation_rule: Missing ephemeral files in a new sandbox do not reset logical project progress. Fetch only what the current runtime actually lacks.

next_execution_sequence.action: Inspect the current execution surface and rehydrate only the exact checkpoint/source/corpus artifacts needed for the next run.

Reassemble and integrity-check lj-med_1000.ckpt as needed, then repeat a tiny direct DWC exact-custom-ID warm-start smoke solely as a reproducibility gate. Record hashes, config, code path, and outcome so this proof is machine-preserved.

Advance immediately beyond the smoke into a bounded acoustic-training run long enough to demonstrate real optimizer/training progress and produce a new checkpoint or equivalent durable training artifact.

If the current CPU/container surface cannot sustain that bounded training run, classify only sustained acoustic training as environment_unavailable and produce/use an exact GPU-ready harness; do not reopen the warm-start, language, corpus, or proxy milestones.

Render a controlled DWC evaluation sample from the newly trained checkpoint and evaluate exact phoneme coverage, pronunciation fidelity, intelligibility, failure cases, and voice quality against the DWC frontend expectations.
Update this durable state with checkpoint hashes, training configuration, evaluation evidence, remaining defects, and the next bounded training/evaluation target.

execution_rules.continue_semantics: Remain in execution mode until the largest safe bounded unit is verified complete or a genuine blocker is fully evidenced.
execution_rules.revalidation_rule: A repeated successful warm-start is a reproducibility/continuity gate. It must not reset the project frontier or be reported as the first proof unless contrary evidence invalidates the prior achievement.
execution_rules.timeout_recovery: Resume at the failing boundary or take the defined environment fallback; do not restart from earlier closed work.
